2. The petitioner apprehend his arrest in connection with Women P.S. Case No.103 of 2021,
registered for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 498(A) and other allied Sections of the Indian Penal Code and  of Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. The allegation against the petitioner is that while informant was sleeping, the petitioner entered into the house of informant and committed raped upon her.

It is also alleged that the petitioner sent vulgar photographs of the informant to her husband's mobile, as a result of which the in-laws of the informant started torturing her and also assaulted her from her matrimonial house.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51309 of 2022(8) dt.18-09-2023 4.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and have committed no offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.

sentences.text: He submits that the petitioner was not present on the alleged place of occurrence, he was in West Bengal.
There is no specific overt act against the petitioner.

5. Learned APP for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail by submitting that there is a specific allegation against the petitioner to commit rape upon the informant.
6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case as well as considering the nature of allegation, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
The prayer for grant of anticipatory bail on his behalf is hereby rejected.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) shikha/-
